site.description: The landing page for @polishd/next, open-source product analytics and design review for Next.js. Visitors read the one-page pitch, copy the install command and follow links to the docs; /AGENTS.md and /llms.txt serve the install procedure to coding agents. /polishd is the owner-only dashboard, and in production it reads the opt-in telemetry from other installs' dashboards rather than this site's own traffic.
site.audience: Developers building Next.js (App Router) apps, often shipped fast with a coding agent
